About This Project

This project identifies environmental zones across a rural landscape using spatial, seasonal, and remote-sensing observations. K-Means clustering groups observations with similar soil moisture, vegetation, temperature, and seasonal profiles. Existing land-cover labels are retained as reference information, not as the prediction target.

Interactive Map

Use the layer control on the map to switch environmental zones on and off. Click individual points to inspect their sensor, environmental, seasonal, and reference-label attributes.
